method: High-16-bit seed votes; top 32 offset buckets, top 5 aligned candidates; BER<.18 triggers waveform checks; BER<.10 and three correlations>.98 corroborate.
limits: Uses existing full-file reference fingerprint snapshot.
Not robust to substantial tempo changes or heavily edited copies.
No match is not proof of musical independence, pure AI creation or copyright status.
No automatic BLOCK or source-label rewrite.

unscorable_files.error: Audio must be at least 10 seconds for duplicate checking.
